Methods for trop objects

Source: R/methods.R
trop-methods.Rd

These methods show the results of a trop() fit and get parts of the results.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'trop'
print(x, digits = 4L, ...)

# S3 method for class 'trop'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.trop'
print(x, digits = 4L, ...)

# S3 method for class 'trop'
coef(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'trop'
confint(object, parm, level = object$conf.level, ...)

# S3 method for class 'trop'
vcov(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'trop'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x, object

A trop object.

digits

The number of significant digits to show.

...

Not used.

parm

Not used. The model has only one parameter, the ATT.

level

The confidence level. Only the level of the fit is available, because the fit contains the interval.

row.names, optional

Not used.

Value

coef() returns the ATT with the name ATT. confint() returns a matrix with 1 row and 2 columns. vcov() returns a matrix with 1 row and 1 column. as.data.frame() returns a data frame with one row for each treated cell and its effect. print() returns x invisibly, and summary() returns a summary object.

On this page

Developed by Alex Farach. The TROP method is from Athey, Imbens, Qu, and Viviano (2026). The authors of the method did not write this package.
